normalization: fit DEM height, Actor state and XY label on train seeds only; preserve DEM mask; path metres and direction raw

training.loss: normalized absolute XY MSE + normalized four Arc-minus-Direct XY MSE
training.selection: lowest aggregate validation loss; test evaluated only after all selections

evaluation.primary: test Arc-minus-same-direction-Direct XY RMSE in metres
evaluation.uncertainty: descriptive seed-level distribution; four env tiles are paired replicates; no population-wide significance claim
evaluation.pilot_interpretation: Pass if full test contrast RMSE improves on direction-mean baseline and no-path, and small overfit passes; otherwise Fail or Inconclusive based on audit/training support. This is not a formal MI-B gate.
